# Tests that pass on Linux and fail on macOS for reasons that are in upstream's
# code, not in the fork's changes. The macOS test job leaves them out, in
# addition to the tests in `upstream-failures.txt`.
#
# Upstream does not build its tests on macOS, so no upstream run can serve as
# a macOS baseline. When a test fails only in the macOS job, find the cause.
# If it lies in code or scripts the fork has not changed, add the test here
# with that cause. If that is not clear from the failure, build the upstream
# commit in `upstream-base` plus the fork's macOS portability commit on a Mac,
# without `-D warnings`, and run the test there: a failure there too puts it
# on this list, a pass makes the failure the fork's to fix. After an update
# from upstream, run the listed tests on a Mac and drop those that pass. One
# test per line: nextest binary id, a space, the test name.
#
# Source: the first four fail on upstream 9ba8eede plus fork commit ee4b6f8e
# and still fail on the fork merged with upstream 9e9dbb89. The last two came
# with upstream 9e9dbb89. All on macOS 27.2 on Apple Silicon, 15 November 2026.

# Two of its 22 Python cases assume Linux: a file name with the byte 0xff,
# which APFS refuses, and a repository created with `core.ignorecase` off.
mcp-agent-mail-guard tests::guard_commit_admission_runs_native_rendered_programs_against_real_git

# The startup probe reports the fixture database as locked by another process.
mcp-agent-mail-server tests::prepared_http_startup_bind_failure_preserves_setup_and_does_not_repeat_probes
mcp-agent-mail-server tests::prepared_http_startup_runs_probes_once_and_callback_after_readiness
mcp-agent-mail-server tests::prepared_http_startup_tui_fallback_bind_failure_does_not_repeat_probes

# Its fixture creates a file whose name is not UTF-8, which APFS refuses.
mcp-agent-mail-tools resources::reservation_activity_tests::reservation_activity_does_not_follow_symlinks_or_lossy_names

# Its shell suite passes every case and then exits nonzero: `scripts/e2e_lib.sh`
# expands empty arrays under `set -u`, which the bash 3.2 of macOS rejects.
mcp-agent-mail-cli::it integration_runs::reservation_parity_shell_suite_uses_cargo_built_binary
